text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I walked down the hallway, Tamamo Cross called out
to me as we passed each other.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you. If ya spot Oguri lookin' lost,
mind givin' her a hand?
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but... what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're currently practicing for that haunted house
"Mummy Hunt" we talked about the other day~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And see, we're the mummies and Oguri's the hunter.
It wouldn't make sense for us, her enemies, to help her out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When enemies start actin' all chummy, there ain't no tension,
so this is our fix for that.
Well then, we're countin' on ya!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... So the elementary school has no stairs in this spot.
How do I get outside...?
choice_data_list: Are you lost by any chance?
Are you lost by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For haunted house practice, we are pretending
the academy is the elementary school building.
And so, I got lost――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: VUGAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Inari. I don't know the way...
Which route should I take to reach the goal?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Why're you askin' me?!
I'm the enemy here!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
At least ask the Trainer over there.
You're supposed to be fightin' tooth and nail against us.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because Tama and the others are so dependable...
Besides, 3 versus 1 is unfair. Let's make it 2 on 2.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Talk about an unreasonable demand.
――Fine, how 'bout this? If the hunter beats the mummies,
I'll make it 2 on 2 for ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Use your hunter weapon... defeat us with the toy gun
to wipe out all the mummies, or escape all the way
to the goal at the Three Goddesses statue. How's that sound?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...All I have to do is win, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho, look at you makin' it sound so easy.
I'll be waitin' to ambush ya at the goal.
Meanin' it's gonna be a race to the Three Goddesses statue, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There's no way you're beatin' me in a race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ............If it's a race............ I'm the one who will win!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-cha~n!
Not that way, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Bang!!
...The shot hit. Creek, eliminated!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Oguri's really pullin' her weight!
Looks like she's finally gotten serious.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, nothin' fires her up
like a race............ Right now!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haa... Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it...! This pressure, Oguri's closin' in!!
But 1st place is――

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: MINE TO TAKE!!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We win, Oguri! A total, complete victory!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah............ Kh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Looks like ya were only payin' attention to Tama, but
I touched yer back too, y'know!
And I gotcha before ya crossed the goal!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Lost the runnin', lost the game too...
Ain't ya just way too weak, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose next time!!
I'll think of a way to beat you, Tama! I will win!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit. The hunter's gotta guide the guests
and work together with 'em. Not us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, good job, Oguri-chan~.
There, there, good girl~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
~~~~Grrr, Creek!!
Your special trainin' continues! No pamperin' during practice!
